name: Design–Build vs Independent ADU Designers in Los Angeles County

mainEntity.name: How do I compare bundled design–build ADU firms with standalone ADU design contractors in Los Angeles County?
mainEntity.text: How do I compare bundled design–build ADU firms with standalone ADU design contractors in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Los Angeles County, you will encounter both design–build ADU firms and independent design contractors who hand off plans to separate builders. Each model has tradeoffs. Design–build firms provide a single contract and point of responsibility for design, engineering, permitting, and construction. This can simplify communication and reduce finger-pointing, since one team controls the process. They often standardize details and finishes, which can improve predictability but may limit customization. Pricing is usually presented as a package, making it harder to compare line items or solicit competing bids. Standalone ADU design contractors, by contrast, allow you to choose any builder once plans are complete, encouraging competitive bidding and potentially better pricing or fit. However, you become responsible for coordinating between designer and builder and resolving conflicts between “as drawn” and “as built.” When deciding, compare not just headline design fees but total project cost, level of customization, and your appetite for managing multiple professionals. Ask design–build firms what happens if you want to take their plans elsewhere, and ask independent designers how they support you during contractor bidding and construction. Your preferred level of involvement and desire for flexibility should guide the choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Design–build ADU firms bundle design, engineering, and construction with a single contract, simplifying coordination but limiting competitive bidding. Standalone ADU design contractors offer more flexibility to bid multiple builders but require you to manage coordination. Compare total cost, transparency, and your comfort managing multiple parties.
